detail.longDescription: Google says AI agents must reach Gmail and Drive through its new Workspace MCP gateways from 1 February 2027 rather than the existing REST APIs. Every call is checked against company permissions and data-loss rules, sensitive actions need human sign-off, and each agent gets its own sign-in ID. A new addendum bars AI tools from training on Workspace data. https:// thenextweb.com/news/google-wor kspace-ai-agents-mcp-servers-rules # Tech # Startup # News # AIAgents
